compiled_state.title: Add fail-closed BLOCK synthesis to dispatch_arbiter on LLM dispatch failure
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: On arbiter LLM dispatch failure (network/auth/timeout): emit fail-closed synthetic rulings — one BLOCK ruling per unresolved critical/important finding with rationale="Arbiter dispatch failed: <error>; defaulting to BLOCK; manual review required."

## TDD Requirement
Add NEW test to tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py:

`test_dispatch_arbiter_fail_closed_on_dispatch_failure`:
- Given: dispatch_review mocked to raise an exception (simulating network/auth failure)
  AND findings list contains 2 critical + 1 minor finding
- When: dispatch_arbiter is called
- Then: returns list of synthetic BLOCK rulings — one per critical/important finding (minor is skipped)
- Each synthetic ruling has rationale containing "Arbiter dispatch failed" AND the original exception message
- schema_version="1.0.0", ruling="BLOCK"

Test must FAIL first (current code raises), then PASS after fix.

## Implementation Notes
Update `dispatch_arbiter` in arbiter.py to wrap dispatch_review in try/except:

```python
try:
    result = dispatch_review(...)
except Exception as e:
    # Fail-closed: synthesize BLOCK rulings for critical/important findings
    return [
        {
            "ruling": "BLOCK",
            "rationale": (
                f"Arbiter dispatch failed: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}; "
                "defaulting to BLOCK; manual review required."
            ),
            "schema_version": "1.0.0",
            "finding_index": i,
        }
        for i, finding in enumerate(findings)
        if finding.get("severity") in ("critical", "important")
    ]
```

The fail-closed list may be empty if no findings are critical/important — that's correct behavior (no blocking ruling for minor-only failures).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Fail-closed test passes
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py::test_dispatch_arbiter_fail_closed_on_dispatch_failure 2>&1 | grep -q passed
- [ ] All arbiter tests still pass after change
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -E "passed"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_path): Fail-closed BLOCK synthesis must be tightened: (1) try/except catches ONLY dispatch transport/LLM errors (subprocess.CalledProcessError, anthropic API errors, JSON parse errors) — NOT bare Exception (would mask downstream bugs as fake BLOCKs); (2) synthesized BLOCK rulings preserve original finding_hash and severity from input finding so the pre-commit gate's diff-hash check still works; (3) empty findings + dispatch failure → return empty rulings array (no-op, not synthesized BLOCK); (4) emit structured stderr log 'arbiter_dispatch_failed reason=<exception_class> finding_count=<n>' for observability.
